summary: Full backend and UI test of the Essence Invest careers platform. Backend: the regression suite test_careers_platform.py passes 29/29 when run serially (-n 0). The new suite test_career_storage_deletion.py passes 5/5. It covers: encrypted GridFS storage (download bytes are identical, including a unicode filename with RFC5987 Content-Disposition); raw chunks contain no plaintext or %PDF; keys are wrapped with Fernet; a 10MB+ file returns 413 and an empty file returns 422; DELETE purges the application doc, the files and chunks, and the key docs, and writes a deletion-log entry without personal data; GET settings returns expired_count and deletion_log; retention/run deletes an application whose updated_at was moved back 200 days; and after re-inserting a deleted application plus a key doc and restarting the backend, reapply_deletion_log removed both. Regression of permissions (recruiting / customer / anonymous) and job management (create/edit/publish-guard/deactivate/draft/delete) passes. The auth playbook checks out: bcrypt $2b$, HttpOnly Secure cookies, CORS with an explicit origin and credentials. UI: anonymous visitors see career-closed on all /karriere routes. With applications disabled, the apply page shows the disabled notice and the submit button is disabled. All 7 inline German errors appear when submitting empty. Invalid email and phone messages, the initiative position error, and inline file errors (docx, gif, >10MB) all work. A UI submission with job preselected, a unicode CV and a PNG shows the exact success text, appears in the recruiting list and detail, downloads with the correct filename, deletes via the UI, and shows up in the settings deletion log. Hero chips, sidebar filters (level/type/location), reset, Enter-search, empty state, sort, detail facts bar, share-copies-link, 404 page, mobile filter sheet and mobile sticky apply all work. There is no horizontal overflow at 390px on 7 career routes. Two real bugs found: (1) the /karriere/stellen search bar is covered by the hero section, so its top and center are not clickable; (2) the legacy /api/career/apply writes into the same career_applications collection and breaks the recruiting list with a 500.

critical.issue: The legacy Hamburg career form (components/career/CareerForm.jsx -> /api/career/apply) is still live and ignores applications_enabled. It inserts into the SAME collection career_applications, using a different schema: name instead of first_name/last_name, the CV stored as plaintext base64 inline in Mongo, and no updated_at. Reproduced by inserting a legacy-shaped doc: GET /api/careers/admin/applications and GET /admin/applications/{id} both return 500 (KeyError first_name in _app_out). Such docs are never covered by retention (no updated_at), and their CV is never encrypted or purged via GridFS. This undermines the promised permanent deletion and the encrypted storage.

minor.issue: Emails are triggered correctly. The UI submission at 10:15 logged no error. During burst tests, however, the Emergent email provider returned 429 and both applicant and admin mails were dropped after 3 quick retries (backoff 1.5s/3s). Consider a longer backoff or a persistent retry queue.

This only triggers if an application doc or a career_file_keys doc exists. Orphan career_files.files/chunks restored without keys would remain. They are encrypted and unreadable, but not physically removed. Consider also checking career_files.files metadata.application_id.
The recruiting role can toggle site_public and applications_enabled, i.e. publish the whole platform. Confirm this is intended, or restrict these toggles to admin.

ui_bugs.issue:
The search bar wrapper uses -mt-12 to overlap the hero, but the hero
paints above the non-positioned wrapper. At both 1920 and 390, elementFromPoint at the top and center of job-search-q and job-search-submit returns the hero . Only the bottom few pixels are clickable, and the bar looks cut off visually (see the screenshot: only its bottom edge is visible below the hero). Playwright's click on job-search-submit timed out because the img intercepted it. Fix: add 'relative z-10' to the '-mt-12' wrapper div (line 61).

issues: 'Frühester Eintrittstermin' uses the native <input type=date>, which shows mm/dd/yyyy (English format) instead of a German/shadcn date picker
Invalid fields get aria-invalid but no red border; only the small text error is shown
The staff preview dropdown lists draft jobs '(Entwurf)'. Submitting with one returns a 404 'Diese Stelle ist nicht mehr verfügbar'
Button reads '1 Stellen anzeigen'; it should use the singular 'Stelle' for 1
The 'Dein Karriereweg' card renders empty when career_path is empty; hide it
The header nav and the 'Jetzt bewerben' CTA are still shown even though every route only shows 'in Vorbereitung'

action_items: Fix the overlap on the /karriere/stellen search bar: add 'relative z-10' to the -mt-12 wrapper in CareerJobs.jsx

Resolve the legacy /api/career/apply collision: write it to a separate collection (e.g. career_legacy_applications), or make _app_out/admin endpoints tolerant (d.get('first_name') ...), gate it by applications_enabled, store its CV via career_files (encrypted) and add updated_at so retention covers it
Optional: replace the native date input with a German-format date picker; singular 'Stelle' in the sheet button; hide the empty Karriereweg card; red border on invalid fields
critical_code_review_comments: routes/career.py (legacy) and routes/careers.py share career_applications with incompatible schemas; _app_out uses d['first_name'], which raises KeyError for legacy docs

reapply_deletion_log iterates the entire log at every startup with 2 queries per entry. That is fine now, but add an index on career_file_keys.application_id and career_files.files metadata.application_id
_maybe_auto_retention runs inside the public /status request path. It is throttled to 6h, but the first request after a restart pays the cost; consider a background task
Running the pytest suite with the default pytest.ini (-n auto, loadscope) causes 8 order-dependent failures in test_careers_platform.py. Run with -n 0

success_rate.backend: 97% (34/34 tests pass; 1 critical issue found by code review and reproduced)
success_rate.frontend: 93% (all flows work; 1 HIGH overlay bug on the job search bar)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Cleanup verified in the DB: settings applications_enabled=false, site_public=false, retention_days=180, notify_email=''; 10 seeded jobs in draft with empty location/employment_type and published_at null; 0 applications, 0 career_files, 0 keys, 0 recruiting users; career_deletion_log test entries (11) removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the career pytest files with '-n 0' (they are order-dependent). test_career_storage_deletion.py submits as staff via localhost:8001 with x-real-ip and an admin Bearer token (site_public stays false), restarts the backend once, and self-cleans its deletion-log entries. For UI tests use 'python backend/tests/career_ui_setup.py up' (enables applications and publishes 2 TEST_ jobs: Berlin/Vollzeit/einsteiger and Hamburg/Teilzeit/erfahren), then 'down' for full cleanup (afterwards delete today's career_deletion_log entries manually). Retest: the search bar overlay (elementFromPoint on job-search-submit must return the button) and the legacy career_applications collision.
rca of the issue: Search bar: the hero section in CareerJobs.jsx is 'relative isolate' (a positioned stacking context). The next sibling wrapper '-mx-auto -mt-12' is not positioned, so per CSS painting order the positioned hero (including its absolute img) paints over the overlapping 48px of the form. Reproduce: open /karriere/stellen and run document.elementFromPoint on the center of [data-testid=job-search-submit] -> IMG. Mitigation: 'relative z-10' on the wrapper. Legacy collision: routes/career.py:100 inserts {name,email,cv:{content(base64)}} into career_applications; careers._app_out reads d['first_name'] and raises KeyError, so the list returns 500. Reproduce: insert such a doc and GET /api/careers/admin/applications -> 500.
